funcao_register_gate_checkin.corpo:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_gatekeeper()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select coalesce(public.current_role() in ('gatekeeper','developer'),false) $function$
